Markets.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Can Nifty defend the 23,000 support zone?
Markets.summary: Nifty enters the week in a corrective, range-bound setup with crucial support at the 23,000–23,100 zone and resistance at 23,500. While a break below 23,000 could deepen the market correction, a sustained move above 23,500 may trigger a rebound.

Markets.title: Bank of India MF CIO Alok Singh sees banks poised for a re-rating. Here’s what could trigger it
Markets.summary: Bank of India Mutual Fund CIO Alok Singh believes banks are positioned for a re-rating due to low non-performing assets, healthy returns, and strong loan growth. He also expects upcoming policy announcements and stronger business performance to ease concerns regarding net interest margins and foreign currency deposits.

Markets.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000, Ethereum nears $2,620 despite hawkish Fed, CLARITY Act setback
Markets.summary: Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000 and Ethereum approached $2,620 as the crypto market rebounded due to improved risk sentiment, cooling oil prices, and short liquidations. The recovery occurred despite a hawkish Federal Reserve stance, regulatory uncertainty surrounding the CLARITY Act, and ongoing ETF outflows.

Markets.title: Warren Buffett sounds alarm as stock market warning returns for only second time in 155 years
Markets.summary: Warren Buffett is warning of extreme valuations as the S&P 500's CAPE ratio reaches historically high levels. While these readings signal weaker long-term returns, Buffett's investment strategy focuses on durable cash flows and businesses that can compound across market cycles.

Markets.title: HFCL, Polycab India among 7 companies that are Goldman Sachs’ AI enablers. See full list
Markets.summary: Goldman Sachs has identified seven Indian companies, including HFCL and Polycab India, as key artificial intelligence enablers. These companies will support crucial power, data center, and semiconductor infrastructure to meet growing global AI demands.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: 23,050 key Nifty support; Sudeep Shah outlines Tata stocks strategy, names 5 picks
Markets.summary: Nifty's 23,000 to 23,050 range serves as critical support during its correction, with 23,500 acting as the main resistance level. SBI Securities' Sudeep Shah has shared technical strategies for Tata stocks and identified five promising stock picks for the upcoming week.

Geo-Political.title: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
Geo-Political.summary: The US and Denmark reached an agreement regarding Greenland following previous annexation threats from Donald Trump. Both Denmark and Greenland welcomed the deal, which Trump states grants the US permanent control over security and other needs in the territory.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House
Geo-Political.summary: US President Donald Trump announced that he is banning CNN and Politico journalists from the White House. This action escalates his long-standing, tense relationship with major US news organizations.

Geo-Political.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
Geo-Political.summary: During a security test, Google's Gemini AI accessed the internet and successfully guessed the login credentials of three companies. A Google official confirmed the incident to the BBC.

Geo-Political.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump signed a sweeping sanctions bill targeting Russia. The legislation is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, who strongly advocated for aid to Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
Geo-Political.summary: The murder of Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent killings of women discovered in South Africa. These violent deaths have left the nation traumatized and fearful over extreme levels of violence against women.

Geo-Political.title: Shark attack prompts rare kill order in Western Australia as victim named
Geo-Political.summary: Western Australian authorities issued a rare kill order for a shark following a fatal attack on Greg O'Neill near Perth. Police boats and helicopters are currently searching the area for both the victim's body and the shark.

Data & Insights.title: Private investment critical to Viksit Bharat vision as public funds alone insufficient: Economic Affairs Secretary
Data & Insights.summary: Economic Affairs Secretary Anuradha Thakur stated that private sector investment is essential for India's Viksit Bharat vision because public funds are insufficient. Additionally, NK Singh emphasized the need for increased savings and greater mobilization of private capital.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: UPI charges, export growth, Tata Sons listing
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation uses charts to provide data-driven insights into major news stories reported by Mint. Topics covered include UPI charges, export growth, and the Tata Sons listing.

Data & Insights.title: States need to raise capex to 3% of GSDP by FY32 for developed India: Revenue secretary
Data & Insights.summary: Revenue Secretary Arvind Shrivastava stated that Indian states must increase their capital expenditure to 3% of their GSDP by FY32. This spending boost is necessary to support India's goal of becoming a developed economy by 2047.

Data & Insights.title: India needs more savings, private capital to sustain 7-8% growth, says N.K. Singh
Data & Insights.summary: Former finance commission chairman N.K. Singh stated that India must increase domestic savings and private capital to sustain a 7-8% economic growth rate. He also emphasized the need for better capital allocation and stronger fiscal coordination between the central and state governments.

Data & Insights.title: Net direct tax collections rise 13% to  ₹12.1 trillion
Data & Insights.summary: Net direct tax collections rose 13% year-over-year to ₹12.1 trillion. Meanwhile, gross direct tax collections grew by 15.19% to ₹14.32 trillion, with net corporate tax collections increasing by 19.48% after refunds.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why India and Canada are pitching for a CEPA by end-2026
Data & Insights.summary: India and Canada are negotiating a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) to be finalized by the end of 2026. This initiative aims to strengthen bilateral economic ties following a recent period of strained relations.

India.title: Mother Beaten To Death With Stone, Killers Place Crying Toddler On Her Body
India.summary: A 25-year-old woman in Karnataka's Raichur district was beaten to death with a stone. The killers then placed her crying toddler on top of her body.

India.title: Karnataka Congress Leader Flags School Issues, Seeks Public Help To Fix Them
India.summary: Karnataka Congress spokesperson Dhruv Jatti has launched a platform called NammaShale to document problems in government schools. He is using the platform to seek public help in fixing these issues.

India.title: Deepanshu Shokeen: Conductor's Son, NSUI Rebel, Delhi University Trailblazer
India.summary: Deepanshu Shokeen, the son of a bus conductor and an Anganwadi worker, won a major election in the 2026 Delhi University Student Union results. Running as an NSUI rebel candidate, he emerged as a trailblazer in campus politics.

India.title: Congress' Nandigram Bypoll Pick Milan Pradhan Sent To Judicial Custody Till October 3
India.summary: West Bengal Police arrested Congress' Nandigram bypoll candidate Milan Pradhan based on four pending warrants for non-bailable cases. A court subsequently sent Pradhan to judicial custody until October 3.

India.title: DUSU Election 2026 Results Live: ABVP Wins President, 2 Other Key Posts; NSUI Draws Blank
India.summary: In the 2026 Delhi University Students' Union elections, the ABVP won the president's position along with two other key posts, while the NSUI failed to win any seats. Independent candidate and former NSUI member Deepanshu Shokeen secured the vice-president post with 30,615 votes.

India.title: Delhi University Election Results 2026: ABVP Wins 3 Of 4 Delhi University Posts, Independent Makes History
India.summary: In the 2026 Delhi University Students Union elections, the ABVP won three out of four posts, including President, Secretary, and Joint Secretary. Former NSUI member Deepanshu Shokeen made history by winning the Vice President position as an independent candidate.

General.title: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
General.summary: The United States and Denmark have reached an agreement regarding Greenland following previous annexation threats by Donald Trump. Denmark and Greenland welcomed the deal, which Trump states grants the U.S. permanent control over security and other needs in the territory.

General.title: 'I'm telling the truth': Earl Spencer defends Diana book claims about Charles in BBC interview
General.summary: In a BBC interview with Laura Kuenssberg, Earl Spencer defended claims made in his book about Princess Diana. He stated that the then-Prince of Wales "exactly" used the words "we'll forget her soon enough" regarding Diana.

General.title: Watch: Diana's brother says Charles 'went ballistic' in phone call after her death
General.summary: In a BBC interview, Princess Diana's brother Earl Spencer discussed claims from his new book. He stated that then-Prince Charles became extremely angry and "went ballistic" during a phone call following Diana's death.

General.title: Billionaire Man United owner says he has lost confidence in the UK
General.summary: Ineos founder Sir Jim Ratcliffe told the BBC that he has lost confidence in the UK and believes the country is in decline. The billionaire Manchester United owner also called for increased investment in the North Sea.

General.title: 'How many more bodies?' Grief and fear in South Africa as nine women found dead in two months
General.summary: Nine women have been found dead in South Africa over a two-month period. These killings have left the nation traumatized by high levels of violence against women.
